_schema.purpose: Flaky tests that are being stabilised. Their failures do not turn the nightly run verdict red; the tests still run and stay visible in reports. See docs/strategy/Test-Report-Dashboard-and-Triage-Plan.md §4.1.
_schema.reason: Why the test is flaky and what is being done.
_schema.match: spec (glob relative to tests/) and optionally test (substring of the title) or testRegex (regex on the title, use ^ when the title is a substring of another, e.g. Process - vs Sub-process -); environment / gateway lists are optional. The error message is ignored.
_schema.expires: At most 30 days after since. Expired entries stop applying and are listed in the verdict.
